instructions: LaminDBAgent 0.2.0 reaches only a LaminHub API address the person set in LAMINDB_API_URL (a host under lamin.ai), with their LAMINDB_API_KEY. The lamin.ai/api address of 0.1.0 is gone (it answers 404). LaminDB itself is a Python library; registry tools on it arrive in 0.3.0. Until then, use lamindb in the Developer shell.

targets.name: hub
targets.title: A LaminHub API address you set (under lamin.ai)
